lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Highly regular grid-like distribution of circular high-luminance spots. Centroids are aligned in approximately four visible longitudinal rows between the mid-dorsal ridge and the pectoral fin insertion, extending toward the caudal peduncle. Inter-blob distance is relatively uniform throughout the mid-section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a distinct checkerboard pattern where the blobs serve as anchor nodes at the intersection points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the lateral flank. Each ridge is characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high-luminance pixels on the dorsal edge and deep shadow on the ventral edge, running parallel to the longitudinal axis.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, diffuse, high-luminance blobs. The spots within the dorsal fin mask are significantly smaller and less defined than the lateral flank constellation, clustered primarily toward the fin base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, irregular notch is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin approximately midway between the apex and the base.
